strings.customwelcomemessage_help:
Accepted formats: Plain text or Moodle-auto format. HTML tags and multi-lang tags are also accepted, as well as the following placeholders:
  • Course name {$a->coursename}
  • Link to course page {$a->courselink}
  • Link to user's profile page {$a->profileurl}
  • User email {$a->email}
  • User fullname {$a->fullname}
  • User first name {$a->firstname}
  • User last name {$a->lastname}
  • User course role {$a->courserole}
